title: The People v Attorney General (Ex Parte Nickson Chilangwa) (2024/CCZ/R001) [2025] ZMCC 9 (10 February 2025)
case_name: The People v Attorney General (Ex Parte Nickson Chilangwa)
issue_tags: imprisonment of MP - automatic vacation of parliamentary seat
by-election triggered by operation of law
outcome_detail: Constitutional reference answered: imprisonment of a Member of Parliament under Article 72(2)(b) read with Article 70(2)(f) triggers automatic vacation of the parliamentary seat as a matter of law; the vacation then triggers a by-election by operation of law; no provision exists for judicial review process during the by-election other than a nomination challenge; an appeal lodged against the conviction has no effect on the vacation of the seat or the ensuing by-election
